title: Perl Language Server settings for LSP4IJ
description: Sparse LSP4IJ projection of the canonical generic perllsp `perl.*` settings contract. Defaults shown here describe server behavior; they are not copied into settings.json.

perl.workspace.includePaths.description: Workspace-relative Perl module roots. Prefer .perl-lsp.toml for shared project configuration.

perl.workspace.useSystemInc.description: Include the selected Perl interpreter's system @INC paths in module resolution.

perl.workspace.usePerl5lib.description: Merge PERL5LIB/PERLLIB paths into module resolution.

perl.workspace.perl5libPrecedence.description: Place PERL5LIB paths before or after configured include paths.

perl.inlayHints.enabled.description: Enable server inlay hints where the client exposes them.

perl.inlayHints.chainedHints.description: Enable hints for supported chained-call contexts.

perl.critic.severity.description: Minimum critic severity: 1 reports more findings; 5 reports only the most severe.

perl.critic.profile.description: Select the native critic rule profile.

perl.formatting.engine.description: Select the server formatting engine. External profile paths/arguments remain outside the workspace LSP settings channel.

perl.formatting.maximumLineLength.description: Maximum line length for supported formatting operations.

perl.formatting.indentColumns.description: Explicit indentation width. Omit to let editor formatting options participate.

perl.formatting.tabs.description: Use tabs when supported by the selected formatting engine.

perl.formatting.openingBraceOnNewLine.description: Place supported opening braces on a new line.

perl.formatting.cuddledElse.description: Use cuddled else/elsif layout for supported blocks.

perl.formatting.spaceAfterKeyword.description: Insert a space after supported control-flow keywords.

perl.formatting.addTrailingCommas.description: Add trailing commas in supported multiline constructs.

perl.formatting.blockCommentIndentation.description: Indentation offset for supported block comments.

perl.telemetry.enabled.description: Enable server telemetry/event notifications to the client.
